prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cohesive 7-icon sprite atlas for a medieval fantasy MMORPG siege-weapon action bar. Primary request: Create seven distinct square ability icons arranged in a perfectly aligned 4 columns by 2 rows atlas. Row 1 left to right: (1) battering ram normal strike, a heavy iron-capped log slamming forward with sparks; (2) empowered battering ram strike, the same ram head surrounded by a powerful orange shockwave; (3) field mortar fire, a dark iron mortar launching one bright flaming shell in a high arc; (4) frost mortar shell, an icy blue mortar shell bursting into sharp frost crystals. Row 2 left to right: (5) venom mortar shell, a green toxic shell with poisonous vapor; (6) catapult boulder, a large rough stone flying with an orange impact trail; (7) catapult cluster barrage, several smaller stones spreading through the air; (8) leave completely empty solid black. Style/medium: hand-painted classic fantasy MMORPG ability icons, matching early-2000s high-contrast spell icons; dramatic highlights, painterly texture, crisp readable silhouettes at 48px. Composition/framing: exact uniform 4x2 grid, each cell perfectly square, subjects centered with safe padding, no overlap between cells; every occupied cell has the same thin ornate antique-gold fantasy frame and dark nearly-black smoky background. Lighting/mood: vivid magical impact lighting, deep shadows, bright focal effects. Color palette: bronze, iron, dark wood, fire orange; frost cyan-blue; venom emerald green. Constraints: no text, no numbers, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no characters, no UI outside the eight equal cells; each icon must be visually distinct and readable when downscaled; exact straight grid boundaries suitable for deterministic cropping.
